title: Credit Builder Accounts Made-Good Relief: Fee Relieved, Making Good and Amount
content:
The made-good relief on a Credit Builder Accounts account is the base relief share of the returned-payment fee, rounded to the cent. The base relief share is 0.3, that is 30 percent.

## The fee relieved and when it is made good

The relief applies to the returned-payment fee charged for the account's most recent returned payment and is owed once that returned payment has been made good, that is once the most recent payment posted toward the due date the returned payment was meant to pay is dated after the return date and has not itself been returned (no return points at it; a payment posted on the return date does not make it good); when two payments were returned, or two were posted toward that due date, on the same day, the one booked first counts as the most recent.

The due date the returned payment was meant to pay is the installment due date on the payment entry that the return line reverses. The return date is the date of the return line.

## When nothing is owed

The relief is not owed, and nothing is booked, when the most recent returned payment carries no returned-payment fee or has not been made good, when that fee already carries a fee waiver or a fee payment, when the plan's courtesy waivers have all been granted on the account in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a waiver dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), or when the relief comes to 0.00.

The courtesy waivers counted are the account's fee waiver entries with the courtesy basis. The plan's number is 1 courtesy waiver per 12 months on the Credit Builder 600, 1000, 1200 and 1800 Plans and 2 on the Credit Builder 2400 and 3000 Plans.

## The amount

The relief share is applied to the fee's amount; a relief share is never more than 100 percent (a share of 1.0). The relief is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end, a half cent or more rounding up, and it is never more than the fee.

## Hypothetical cases (fee 10.00, Credit Builder 1200 Plan)

| Returned payment and later payments toward its due date | Courtesy waivers in the 12 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| returned 4 May; a payment posted 9 May, not returned | none | 30 percent of 10.00, that is 3.00 |
| returned 4 May; a payment posted 4 May | none | not owed: a payment on the return date does not make it good |
| returned 4 May; no later payment toward its due date | none | not owed: not made good |
| returned 4 May; a payment posted 9 May, not returned | one, dated today | not owed: the plan's one courtesy waiver is used |
